title: AI, kas pārbauda cita AI darbu un atmaksā klientam naudu
seoTitle: AI kvalitātes kontrole e-komercijā | Mārketinga Skola
description: Kā otrs modelis vērtē katru AI ģenerēto rezultātu, pirms klients to redz: slieksnis 85 %, trīs mēģinājumi, automātiska atmaksa un cilvēka pārbaude.
facts: The source is Rihards Zeila's own English guide (rihardszeila.com/blog/ai-review-layer), written from systems he runs himself. Take its content, numbers and steps; write the Latvian fresh, not sentence by sentence.
Never name the print-on-demand store, and never say or hint at what it sells, its theme or its niche: it is only 'a print-on-demand ecommerce project'.
